models.name: Eco-Friendly Water Bottle
models.description: A sustainable 500ml water bottle featuring a BPA-free polymer body and a precision-threaded cap. The design focuses on ergonomic grip and high-clarity material simulation, demonstrating advanced transparency shaders in Three.js.
models.designChoices: Chosen for its simplicity in form but complexity in material properties (IOR for plastic and liquid).

models.name: Classic Soda Can
models.description: The standard 330ml aluminum soda can. This model showcases high-quality UV mapping and PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials to simulate brushed metal and glossy branding. Includes a fully rigged pull-tab animation.
models.designChoices: Selected to demonstrate the integration of branding textures and metallic reflectivity in a web environment.

models.name: Recycled Crushed Can
models.description: An experimental model showing the result of physical deformation on a metal mesh. This represents the 'end of life' cycle of the product, utilizing complex vertex positions and optimized topology to maintain a low poly count for the web.
models.designChoices: Created using Blender cloth simulation to provide a non-uniform mesh for testing advanced wireframe rendering.
